_comment: Hospital in-house drug code -> page. URL form: <baseUrl>?code=XXXX (or d/<slug>/?code=XXXX). status: active | disabled. target: 'd/<slug>' (40 detailed pages) or 't/<technique>'. One code maps to one active target. Codes below are SYNTHETIC examples only; replace with real HIS codes. Governance (v1.3): every code carries license (藥品許可證字號 of the product the HIS code dispenses), maintainer (who keeps this row) and confirmedAt (YYYY-MM-DD the hospital last confirmed it). Leave empty until the hospital provides them; the build prints a warning for every empty field and checks for duplicate/case-conflicting codes, unknown targets and license mismatches.
